description: This file defines a PHP class ConfigHelper within the OrangeHRM namespace, responsible for generating and retrieving various configuration paths and settings related to the OrangeHRM project, such as directory paths for sources, plugins, configs, and client assets. It includes methods for discovering plugin configurations and assembling global configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A helper class to generate and retrieve configuration paths and settings for the OrangeHRM project, including support for plugin configurations and client-side assets.

methods.name: getPathConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves key filesystem paths based on the current directory, including base project path, source directory, config directory, and others.

methods.name: getPluginConfigs
methods.description: Discovers plugin directories ending with 'Plugin', retrieves their configurations, and returns an array of plugin info and configuration data.

methods.name: getPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Given a plugin directory, scans for plugin configuration PHP files and returns an array with configuration details, or null if none found.

methods.name: getClientConfigs
methods.description: Gathers client-related configuration paths such as web assets and build timestamps.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigs
methods.description: Returns global configuration flags, such as internationalization and date formatting settings.

methods.name: getConfigs
methods.description: Aggregates and returns all configuration data by calling the various get methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by name, with optional default fallback.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new parameters into the internal configurations array.
